key_insight: PhiBE-PI learns continuous-time policies from a fixed batch of discrete-time off-policy transitions using one state-action critic while preserving the action-ranking signal at small sampling intervals.
engineering_relevance: The framework supports policy learning for unknown stochastic dynamics without explicitly estimating drift or diffusion or collecting fresh data at every iteration.
method: Learn a critic directly from sampled state increments.
Improve the policy and reuse the same batch across iterations.
Use linear function approximation with a local end-to-end suboptimality guarantee.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical error bounds covering time discretization, function approximation, and finite-sample evaluation, including dependence induced by batch reuse, but describes no empirical benchmarks.
watch_item: Smaller sampling intervals reduce discretization error but can increase statistical error at fixed sample size, so finer sampling need not improve policy performance.
paper_title: A Model-Free Continuous-Time RL Algorithm from Discrete-Time Off-Policy Data with End-to-End Guarantees
